div.style: color: rgb(123, 123, 115) !important; font-size: 12px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What Strictness does
• Coverage floor (this gate)
• How close two efforts must be to substitute
• How many paired comparisons an estimate needs
• How wide the peer release window is
• 100 = no estimates at all

div.style: color: rgb(123, 123, 115) !important; font-size: 12px !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What the lineup fit does
Picks the weights only.
Never excludes models.
Never marks benchmarks optional anymore.
